cases.name: Meaghan "Meggy" Burns
cases.about: Born in Springfield, Burns moved with her family to South Deerfield in 2004, her obituary says. She enlisted in the U.S. Navy on Sept. 15, 2015, and had served as a hospital corpsman in Naples, Italy, before serving in Portsmouth. “She was a proud sailor and was planning to further her career in healthcare at the end of her enlistment,” the obituary says.

cases.name: Shianne T. Soles
cases.about: Soles’ family said in a statement to The Virginian Pilot that she joined the Navy to help make the world a better place. She enlisted on July 18, 2018, according to Gulick. She was described as a “bright light” who was always ready to help others, The Pilot reports.
